newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London barely changed.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London were barely changed on Wednesday in quiet trading but with some interest in the banking sector, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 7.33 points, or 0.05 percent, at 15,072.35 points.
Earlier the Hang Seng Index in Hong Kong closed 174.06 points, or 1.17 percent, higher at 15,065.02, touching a high of 15,200.96 in the morning session, as the market followed the Dow's strong lead.
Traders expected further gains before the market closes for the handover festivities.
"Apart from the banks it was a fairly quiet day in London," one trader said.
Among the banks, HSBC Holdings gained HK$2.25 to HK$233.625.
The Hong Kong Stock Exchange will be closed from June 28 until July 3 to mark the territory's handover to China.
